title: The motel owner who wanted only three of the band
summary: After an audition, a motel owner offers to hire only part of the six-piece band; they also play between prize fights and he cannot keep the house.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: You did play quite a few jobs--

Oh, we played a lot of jobs around but got no money for it. And, you just--- we just couldn't sell anything. I'll give you an example of what I'm talking about -- a guy called me up once that had a beautiful room in a motel; he wanted some music and he said - "I hear you got a good band, Mr. Davision" - so and so - and I said -- "yes, I have the best band in California." He said - Can I hear it? And, I said -well you know, I wish I could have said we're playing such and such but we weren't. And, I said the only way you can hear is for us to make an audition and I haven't made an audition in 20 years.

Or more. And, so, he said - could you come over on Friday afternoon - so, we all assembled and went over there and played and he sat there with his girl - bought us all a drink and we played our hearts out and then, I said -- I've played all that I thought we should do and all our little fancy numbers and I said - all right, fellows, I'll go talk to the boss and I'll give you a call. So, I went over and sat down with him and he said, well, Mr. Davison, you've got a wonderful band - just wonderful. He said - I can use three of you. And, I said,

what the hell are you talking about? He said - yeah, I can use the piano, bass - or the piano or drums and you or the piano, bass and you. And, with that, I didn't even say thank you - good-bye - drop dead -- I just walked out because, you know, this is what I'm talking about. And, I even did such things out on the Coast as play for the---
He would have expected the three to sound like the whole band- right?

Yeah, but he had a nerve to ask for the whole band when he knew I had six and then say he wants three. Why didn't he tell me he wanted three on the phone. And, we did such things as play prize fights -- between the fights to make a buck here and there, you know and, so, I not only couldn't pay for my home that I bought but I had to get the hell out.
